entities.name: Vladimir Pešić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimir Pešić is a scientist from Montenegro, and a biologist who is an expert on Hydrachnidiae, the water mites. He is also a co-author taxon authority for a new species of freshwater snail Glöer & Pešić, 2008. Pešić works in the Department of Biology at the University of Montenegro, at Podgorica.
